questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Housing can be very expensive! Look up 'scape', 'Iglu' or use 'flatmates' to find a place to stay. 'Student one' is by far the most expensive!

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: UQ is very accomodating with regards to helping out their students. Go to campus and ask for any help.

questions.answer: Semi, it was difficult for me to find classes which could be approved from my own Uni.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The quality of learning is not very high.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: My MA course had a VERY easy exam. Otherwise, they are trying to teach you a lot, but the quality of that is not the highest.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Far worse. Uni in UCPH is a lot more well-thought out and far more mathematic. Down in Australia it is certainly not.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Brisbane itself is okay, but it is mainly a hub for you to travel to the rest of Queensland. There are so many great spots to visit up and down the coast, go nuts with those.
Have fun
QUEST is their social exchange student organisation, and they do a lot of fun things.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Enjoy

questions.answer: All of the travelling and awesome experiences you will get.

questions.answer: Having enough time for everything.
